inputs.title: The [Ar II] ejecta of Cassiopeia A, 10632 cells of the model of DeLaney et al. (2010) as places and speeds, with its outer optical knots (2036 cells) and jets (955 cells) beyond the forward shock
inputs.acquisition: Built from the Chandra X-ray Center's zip of the model's ASCII VTK files by the generator, which downloads the zip, reads newar-ascii.vtk, and newopt-ascii.vtk and newjets-ascii.vtk beyond the forward shock grown by free expansion to this bank's picture's epoch, 2025 October 25 (`--bank=cassiopeia-a-2025-layers`), and writes each cell of one model unit as a row. Restored from the source cache; not tracked.
